messages.subject: Project Skylark - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert, Grace,

Attached are draft non-binding heads of terms reflecting the commercial shape we discussed: £5m upfront, 4.5% running royalty stepping to 3.0% after £15m cumulative, £1.5m + £2.0m milestones, £1m annual minimum from Year 3, and a £10m liability cap with an uncapped IP indemnity. These are opening positions - expect Caldera to push.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
